title: Prompt package example
objective: Build one public-safe capability project and importable backup for a useful prompt: extract action items with source references. Generate its package with the real generator, add representative input/expected-output cases and explain that model behavior is not yet evaluated.
acceptance: Backup parses, export matches generator, cases distinguish authored expectations from executed checks.

title: Agent Skill package example
objective: Build one public-safe capability project and backup for a repository handoff skill. Generate package via existing generator and add trigger/non-trigger examples, provenance and a manual evaluation recipe. Do not install or publish a skill.
acceptance: Backup roundtrip and generated SKILL.md verified; no claim of model execution.

title: Workflow package example
objective: Build a capability project and backup for a local release evidence checklist. Generate the workflow package and provide a worked synthetic pass/fail walkthrough with explicit human steps.
acceptance: Backup/generator checks pass; worked example is labeled synthetic; no execution-engine claim.

title: Software starter example
objective: Build a JSON contract-inspector capability example using the existing software generator. Include importable backup, generated source, valid/invalid/hostile input cases and a repeatable smoke checker.
acceptance: Actual starter behavior checked with available runtime; manual browser checks reported separately.

title: ZIP portability regression
objective: Add nonredundant tests against buildCapabilityZip for Unicode names/content, CRC and entry bytes, empty files and unsafe paths. Use an independent standard reader if practical. Do not change generator.
acceptance: Boundary tests reproduce expected archive behavior; actual defects documented with minimal reproduction.

title: Backup byte-boundary regression
objective: Add table-driven parser/export tests at UTF-8 field and project count boundaries, unknown envelopes and mutation isolation, covering gaps beyond existing nine tests. Do not change parser.
acceptance: Boundary failures and accepted edge cases are explicit and assertions do not mirror implementation.

title: Storage recovery regression
objective: Add isolated tests for unavailable storage, quota failures, recovery backup preservation and capability/GPT namespace separation. Restore globals and module state between scenarios. Do not change storage.
acceptance: Tests verify preservation under failure; no cross-test state leak.

title: Evidence wording regression
objective: Verify all generated package types keep authored evidence separate from behavioral proof and publication permission, including reviewed=true and empty/whitespace evidence. Do not change generator.
acceptance: Tests cover meaningful missing branches; report discovered defects instead of weakening assertions.

title: Keyboard and dialog acceptance
objective: Add focused keyboard navigation and dialog focus tests for capability import/delete and project selection. Use existing Playwright infrastructure and own PORT. No application changes.
acceptance: Runnable test with focused pass/fail evidence and keyboard limitations.

title: Narrow viewport acceptance
objective: Add bounded responsive checks at 320 and 390px with long project names and package filenames; test light/dark overflow and usable controls. No CSS or runtime edits.
acceptance: Reproducible viewport assertions; defects include selectors and screenshots when possible.

title: Studio coexistence acceptance
objective: Add nonredundant coverage for workbench/studio browser Back/Forward navigation and independent project persistence across reload. Do not modify source or existing tests.
acceptance: Both stores retain seeded data; route history tested without resetting unrelated browser state.

title: Structured contract parser prototype
objective: Implement a pure standalone versioned JSON contract parser with field names, primitive type, required flag and helpful path errors. Reject duplicate fields and unknown versions. Add adjacent coop-contract.test.ts. Do not wire into UI or replace free-text inputs.
acceptance: Positive/negative tests; documented experimental API; no claim existing projects migrated.

title: Executable evidence record prototype
objective: Implement a pure standalone result-record validator with package digest, environment, command, result(pass/fail/inconclusive/not-run), timestamp and evidence reference. Add coop-result.test.ts. Do not execute commands or interpret prose as proof.
acceptance: Invalid or missing evidence cannot yield a verified result; caller trust boundary documented.

title: Package fingerprint prototype
objective: Implement a standalone async SHA-256 fingerprint for generated file path/content pairs with canonical ordering, unambiguous framing, duplicate-path rejection and no network. Add coop-fingerprint.test.ts.
acceptance: Order invariant; bytes/path changes alter digest; Unicode and delimiters covered; no UI integration.

title: Project revision diff prototype
objective: Implement a pure diff of two CapabilityProject values, separating authored-field changes from id/timestamp metadata, with deterministic ordering and no HTML rendering. Add coop-project-diff.test.ts.
acceptance: Empty and edited diffs, Unicode and malicious text safely returned as data; no store or UI changes.

title: Safe import merge planner
objective: Implement pure dry-run plan for merging two valid CapabilityWorkspace values. Identify identical, conflicting and new project IDs; never overwrite or mutate inputs and flag project-count overflow. Add coop-import-plan.test.ts. No actual writes.
acceptance: Deterministic plan covers identity collisions and bounds; conflict resolution remains explicit.

title: Backup migration design
objective: Write an implementation-ready migration contract around the actual version1 backup schema: dispatch by version, preserve original bytes, dry-run preview, unknown-version failure, recovery fixtures and rollback. Do not invent historical supported schemas.
acceptance: Exact current fields cited; proposed future changes labeled; acceptance fixture matrix included.

title: Skillz reference parser prototype
objective: Implement standalone parsing for explicit canonical OKHP3/skillz GitHub blob references with optional immutable commit revision; distinguish pinned from mutable references, reject other hosts/repos and credential-bearing URLs. Add coop-skill-reference.test.ts. No fetch/catalog copying.
acceptance: Pinned and unpinned cases, malformed URLs and userinfo covered; original text preserved.

title: External agent handoff generator
objective: Implement a standalone text handoff generator from CapabilityProject plus explicit baseSHA, allowed files, acceptance and budget fields. Mark project text as source data, leave authorization with caller, and include evidence-return fields. Add coop-agent-handoff.test.ts. No agent dispatch or execution.
acceptance: Stable output with unsafe text treated as data, missing required metadata rejected, no publication authority invented.

title: Current release evidence addendum
objective: Create a dated source-and-GitHub-backed addendum to maturation report verifying PR23/24, exact main and checks. Preserve historic assessment; map shipped state versus remaining roadmap. Only current repo reads and this new document.
acceptance: Exact evidence links and retrieval time; Replit state unknown unless directly verified; no production-readiness inflation.

title: FoundRy feature-page contract tests
objective: Create focused standard-library Python checks for canonical FoundRy source versus the current application contract: primary app link, separate GPT studio, local storage/recovery, target kinds and honest evidence language. Read old dispatch; avoid general project-status framework changes.
acceptance: Passing current invariants plus explicit opt-in expected-future checks for real parity defects; default CI remains unchanged.

title: FoundRy embed acceptance harness
objective: Add an isolated read-only browser acceptance script for the FoundRy embed and direct-app fallback: sandbox affordances, open-app link, keyboard access and downloadable-backup limits. Use existing dependencies; no sandbox permission or runtime edits.
acceptance: Actual current behavior recorded with bounded assertions; no silent sandbox broadening; invocation documented.

title: Feature-page metadata parity audit
objective: Audit only FoundRy page title, description, social metadata, iframe title and alt text against released workbench. Provide exact before/after copy and owning source locations as a reviewable candidate. Preserve owner voice; do not edit shared config/generated HTML.
acceptance: Every proposed claim grounded in current FoundRy source; current/future distinctions explicit.

title: FoundRy recovery and export FAQ candidate
objective: Draft exact replacement FAQ copy for named projects, backup/import, source ZIP versus GPT exports, origin-specific storage and capability release boundary. Map each paragraph to source evidence and destination block. Preserve origin story.
acceptance: Ready-to-apply content candidate; no false runtime or blanket licensing claims; no page edits.

title: FoundRy redirect and launch regression
objective: Add focused tests for legacy /found-ry/ redirect, canonical /projects/found-ry/ route, app launch URLs and no confusing redirect to legacy studio. Use existing source/generated distinction; no generated edits.
acceptance: Route-specific assertions and fixtures; current defects reproduced, not hidden by changing expected URLs.

title: Feature journey challenger review
objective: Act as independent challenger of the current feature page: can a first-time visitor choose workbench versus GPT studio, understand actual output, recover work and find the correct app? Identify five-or-fewer prioritized evidence-backed improvements with exact copy/markup candidates. Do not repeat whole-site A20 audit.
acceptance: Evaluate clarity, claim accuracy, parent CSS reuse and keyboard/mobile implications; no speculative redesign or shared runtime edits.
